rationale: Every artifact use of claim C-CHAL-004 consistently preserves its scope and limitations. The claim states that EASA's proposed DS.AI does not cover AI systems contributing to fatalities or multiple life-threatening injuries, excludes certain online-learning systems, and therefore cannot be presented as a complete path for the most demanding flight-critical autonomy case. All artifacts explicitly acknowledge the 'proposed' status of EASA NPA 2025-07(B) and its high-consequence scope exclusions, ensuring it is not misrepresented as a final or complete solution for the hardest cases. No omitted qualifications, changed status, or inferences presented as authority evidence were found.
